body:
Although great performance of Esen, film has a weak story. Sudden pass from his teenager years to adult was very disappointing. Some parts of the film is rather than a film story it seems like documentary or vice versa . Also a paragraph for the young actor Sahin Kendirci (young Muslum). I congratulate him from heart for his great performance which made us cry. Zerin Tekindor was perfect in the role of Muhterem Nur.

As a result, rather than story great performances saves the film being a bad one
Very sad life. very successful in acting not boring at all perfect film

This can be the best biographic movie of Turkish cinema. Timucin Esen's acting was a nirvana. The little kid was good too. I laughed and cried at the theatre... Pure art and a good salute for a good man...

This is biography of the best arabesque music singer Muslum . A very dramatic life story. Of course there is some negative things for movie. But this is unimportant. Because there are very few examples in Turkish Cinema.( for biography) Anyway, definitely watch the movie and feel the Muslum's pain.

This movie is a milestone for Turkish cinema industry. Beside the amazong performance of Timucin Esen, cinematography is very sophisticated and visionary for Turkish cinema (i put Nuri Bilge Ceylan in other category ofcourse). Respect to actors, amazing performances.
